title: Széchenyi István, a legnagyobb magyar (István Széchenyi, 'the Greatest Hungarian')
grammar: Evidential & Modal Particles in Reformist Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what István Széchenyi offered in 1825 and what came of it.
I can use állítólag, bizonyára and feltehetően to say how sure a statement is.
I can name Széchenyi's book, the Hitel, and the institution founded after his offer.
I can use eight new words about Széchenyi and the Reform Age.
